BackstoryDef.title: Skynet combat platform
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was assembled as a Skynet combat platform. Every subsystem was designed to locate, pursue, and eliminate designated threats without hesitation.

BackstoryDef.title: Skynet infiltration unit
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was created to pass among humans, collect intelligence, and strike when detection was least likely. Organic behavior is a tool; the mission remains absolute.
